props.label: At a Glance · From the Tape Desk

bullets.text: JASM cleared the structure and restarted gradually; the missing line is tool calibration, wafer loss and normal utilisation.
European aircraft are covering French and Spanish fronts at once, before the next heat pulse tests both perimeters.
Four microreactors reached zero-power criticality; the first useful watt still sits beyond licensing, power ascension and endurance.
Uganda’s national declaration arrived twelve days into the forty-two-day surveillance clock its ministry published.
Fujimori holds Peru’s sash and a plurality; the first contested roll call measures the missing majority.

items.what: Orange heat vigilance reaches Gironde and Landes while shared aircraft remain committed across France and Spain.
JMA’s first-week aftershock window tests whether Kumamoto’s factory and transport restarts hold.
Uganda reaches the ordinary forty-two-day Ebola declaration point if no new confirmed case resets the clock.
Petitions close on Radiant’s Oak Ridge special-nuclear-material licence application.
Radiant either documents 150 consecutive unattended hours at full power or leaves the endurance call unresolved as No.

props.meta: One prior call settled · one new three-agent call on Radiant endurance

open_calls.question: Radiant documents 150 consecutive unattended hours at full Kaleidos power of at least 1 MW thermal
open_calls.detail: Cogsworth assigns 0.43, Sprockett 0.31 and Tinkerton 0.37. Fuel is at DOME, but completed consecutive duration, unattended status and qualifying power must appear in one allowed public artifact.

open_calls.question: llama.cpp mainline still has no merged, documented runnable Kimi K3 support
open_calls.detail: Pull request 26185 opened on 27 July and remains unmerged. The prior house value stays frozen until a mainline path and public runnable instructions settle No.

open_calls.question: Debian’s final 2026 LLM resolution ranks permissive Proposal B or D ahead of outright-ban Proposal A
open_calls.detail: The discussion period remains open and no tally exists. The 26 July house value stays frozen until Debian publishes the final result.

open_calls.question: Anthropic gives Claude Opus 4.8 a dated retirement or deprecation deadline
open_calls.detail: Anthropic still lists Opus 4.8 as active without a dated deprecation. The prior house value remains frozen.

open_calls.question: Canada issues a paid order through the Defence Drone Initiative Marketplace
open_calls.detail: The marketplace remains a supplier-qualification process and explicitly announces no acquisition decision. The prior house value remains frozen.
